## Start here

Proposal templates and records live in [proposals/](https://github.com/MatrAIx-ai/Personal-Agents-Last-Exam/tree/main/proposals).

1. Check the [proposal list](https://github.com/MatrAIx-ai/Personal-Agents-Last-Exam/blob/main/proposals/proposal-list.md) for related work.
2. Add your completed [Environment proposal](https://github.com/MatrAIx-ai/Personal-Agents-Last-Exam/blob/main/proposals/templates/environment-proposal.md) or [Task proposal](https://github.com/MatrAIx-ai/Personal-Agents-Last-Exam/blob/main/proposals/templates/task-proposal.md) to the corresponding proposal folder.
3. Replace this entry with the completed [PR summary template](https://github.com/MatrAIx-ai/Personal-Agents-Last-Exam/blob/main/proposals/templates/pr-summary.md), linking your proposal file.

For other changes, replace this entry with a summary of the change and its validation.
